name: The Living Universe
oneLiner: Every build, essay, video and short is a light in a 3D sky placed by its topic and date, joined by the links Ken actually wrote, with the automated Digest as a separate dust lane that cools and goes still when publishing is paused.
type: Instrument Serif (display and headings) · Hanken Grotesk (body and universe labels, carried over from production) · JetBrains Mono (data, dates, kickers; also production). All self-hosted latin woff2.
signature: A living, data-placed universe you can orbit, fly through and replay month by month, where following a thread carries a light along a documented link to the related work, and the Digest's dust lane shows its real daily volume and its derived publishing status.
